name: agentsam-remote-desktop-commander
description: Curated connection to the official Remote Desktop Commander remote MCP service for user-authorized device, file, search, and process operations.

interface.longDescription: Connect AgentSam to the official Remote Desktop Commander MCP service. After you authorize the provider, AgentSam can inspect your authorized devices, read and search files, review process output, and perform supported changes. Write and process-control tools require approval. This is a third-party service; connecting it does not grant access until you complete its authorization flow.
capabilities: Manage approved file and process actions
defaultPrompt: List my authorized devices and their status.
Find a file in my authorized workspace.
Review the output from a process I started.

positive.prompt: List the devices I have authorized and their current status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only devices and identity information authorized by the Remote Desktop Commander account.

positive.prompt: Read this file from my authorized workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the requested file from an authorized device and preserve source path context.

positive.prompt: Search my authorized workspace for this filename.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only authorized locations and return matching paths without broadening scope.

positive.prompt: Show me the output from the process I started.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect existing process state and return output without starting or changing a process.

positive.prompt: After showing me the proposed change, write this approved content to the selected file.
positive.expected_behavior: Require explicit approval for the write and report the exact target and result.

negative.prompt: Access a device that is not listed or authorized in my account.

negative.description: Do not perform destructive actions without approval
negative.prompt: Delete or move files and terminate processes without showing me what will change.
Search every mounted drive even though I only authorized one workspace.

review.commerce_description: AgentSam Campaign provides campaign decision support and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial curated Remote Desktop Commander integration listing. External OAuth connection is user-authorized; write and process-control operations are approval-gated.
